data.title: Seaside Hills Residences
data.about:
Discover the epitome of coastal elegance at Seaside Hills Residences, a premier destination within the Al Zorah development, offering an unparalleled beachfront living experience. This exclusive community is a haven of luxury, where the Seaside Hills residences cater to those seeking a lifestyle that combines the serenity of seaside living with the splendor of upscale amenities.

Seaside Hills Residences Al Zorah Apartments for sale present a diverse selection of 1 to 4-bedroom homes, each crafted to perfection to ensure a life of luxury and comfort by the sea. The spacious terraces of these residences provide breathtaking views that span from the scenic coastline to the expansive horizon, encapsulating the beauty of Seaside Hills Al Zorah. The interiors at Seaside Hills Residences are a testament to modern elegance, with a design that balances contemporary sophistication with the warmth of a welcoming home. This serene retreat is designed for those who cherish the tranquility of the sea and the luxury of refined living.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxury Apartments: 1 to 4 bedroom waterfront seaside hills apartments in Ajman, UAE, by Solidere International.
  • Waterfront Views: Limited series of 90 units with expansive sea views at Seaside Hills Residences Al Zorah.
  • Nature-Inspired Living: Eco-friendly, modern lifestyle amidst greenery and waterfront at Seaside Hills Residences.
  • Prime Location: Easy access to city landmarks and beachfront tranquility at Seaside Hills Residence Al Zorah.
  • Amenities Galore: Access to resorts, a golf course, wellness facilities, and pristine beaches near Seaside Hills Residences.
  • Green Spaces: Over 60% greenery, community pool, indoor/outdoor gym, and private beach at Seaside Hills Residences Al Zorah.
  • Security: 24/7 CCTV surveillance for a secure living environment at Seaside Hills Residences.
  • Outdoor Activities: Pedestrian walkways, cycling track, children’s playground, and terraces overlooking lush landscapes at Seaside Hills Residences.
  • Golf Course: A 700,000 square meter course by Troon, enhancing the luxurious lifestyle at Seaside Hills Residences Al Zorah.
  • Biodiversity: A 100-hectare mangrove forest with 200 bird species, emphasizing the eco-conscious setting of Seaside Hills Residences.

location_tile.title: Beachfront Views in Seaside Hills Residences Al Zorah.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the beachfront Al Zorah neighborhood of Ajman, United Arab Emirates, the Seaside Hills Residences are the pinnacle of seaside living. Located on the banks of the Arabian Gulf, the coastal treasure of Al Zorah offers a one-of-a-kind way of life that combines the serenity of nature with luxurious living. This ideal location offers the best of both worlds: tranquil living close to major cities and quick access to Sharjah and Dubai. Spread up approximately 5.4 million square meters, Seaside Hills Al Zorah is home to a wide variety of ecosystems thanks to its undisturbed beaches, lush mangroves, green woods, and picturesque salt flats.

Located in the heart of Al Zorah, the championship golf course was created by the renowned Jack Nicklaus. It offers an unparalleled opportunity to play golf amidst stunning natural scenery. This elite neighborhood is built around the Al Zorah Golf Club, which provides its residents with a lifestyle of leisure and elegance. It is also anchored by Seaside Hills Residences, luxury hotels, and gourmet eating locations.

  • 10 Minutes - Al Zorah Natural Reserve
  • 12 Minutes - Ajman China Mall
  • 15 Minutes - Emirates Markets
  • 20 Minutes - Sharjah International Airport
  • 30 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
